groups.name: common.mvc.async-executor
groups.description: Configuration properties for the bounded Spring MVC async executor.

properties.name: common.mvc.async-executor.core-pool-size
properties.description: Core number of threads for the MVC async executor.

properties.name: common.mvc.async-executor.max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed number of threads for the MVC async executor.

properties.name: common.mvc.async-executor.queue-capacity
properties.description: Capacity of the bounded queue for MVC async tasks.

properties.name: common.mvc.async-executor.keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Idle thread keep-alive time in seconds.

properties.name: common.mvc.async-executor.shutdown-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for tasks to finish during shutdown.

properties.name: common.mvc.async-executor.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Thread name prefix for MVC async worker threads.
